title: Lightlark
author: Alex Aster
summary: A young ruler travels to a hidden island for a deadly tournament that happens once every hundred years. She has to survive its games, where rival rulers hold secrets, and may have a way of breaking an old curse.
readIf: you want a fast, YA-friendly romantasy with a tournament and a lot of mysteries.
skipIf: you want deep worldbuilding or a rich prose style, as the book moves fast.

pairings.reason: Another story where a young woman is forced into a lethal contest against people with their own agendas.
Shares the court-style cruelty and a heroine who must be clever to survive.
A fast young-adult romantasy with a trials setting and a prince on the other side.
